uncited: - **Input:** A set of predicted segmentation masks $P = \{p_1, ..., p_N\}$ and ground-truth masks $G = \{g_1, ..., g_N\}$ for $N$ classes.
- Binary masks for each class $c$, where $1$ indicates the class is present and $0$ otherwise.
- Counters for True Positives ($TP_c$), False Positives ($FP_c$), and False Negatives ($FN_c$) for each class.
Identify True Positives ($TP_c$): Voxels/pixels where both prediction $p_c$ and ground truth $g_c$ are $1$.
Identify False Positives ($FP_c$): Voxels/pixels where prediction $p_c$ is $1$ but ground truth $g_c$ is $0$.
Identify False Negatives ($FN_c$): Voxels/pixels where prediction $p_c$ is $0$ but ground truth $g_c$ is $1$.
Handle the edge case where the denominator is zero (no voxels predicted or present for class $c$).
Sensitive to class imbalance if not averaged correctly (though mIoU averages per-class, rare classes still contribute equally to the mean, which can be a strength or weakness depending on the goal).
